description: Simulated binary data with a constant-response group (z2 = g4) and a region completely separated by x (z1 > 0.65); y_plain has no separation.
generator_code:
{
    n <- 500L
    d <- data.frame(x = rnorm(n), z1 = runif(n), z2 = factor(sample(c("g1", "g2", "g3", "g4"), n, replace = TRUE)), 
        z3 = rnorm(n))
    u <- runif(n)
    y <- as.integer(u < plogis(-0.3 + 0.8 * d$x))
    sep <- d$z1 > 0.65
    y[sep] <- as.integer(d$x[sep] > 0)
    y[d$z2 == "g4"] <- 0L
    d$y <- y
    d$y_plain <- as.integer(u < plogis(ifelse(d$z1 <= 0.5, -0.5 + 1.2 * d$x, 0.5 - 0.8 * d$x)))
    d$d4 <- as.numeric(d$z2 == "g4")
    d
}
